88:     std::string_view text,
89:     const std::array<std::pair<std::string_view, std::string_view>, N>&
90:         replacements) {
91:     std::string rendered;
92:     rendered.reserve(text.size());

96:         size_t start = text.find("{{", pos);

98:             rendered.append(text.substr(pos));
99:             break;
100:         }
101:

103:         if (end == std::string_view::npos) {
104:             rendered.append(text.substr(pos));
105:             break;
106:         }
107: 
108:         rendered.append(text.substr(pos, start - pos));
109:         std::string_view placeholder = text.substr(start, end + 2 - start);
110:         bool replaced = false;
111:         for (const auto& [from, to] : replacements) {
112:             if (placeholder == from) {
113:                 rendered.append(to);
114:                 replaced = true;
115:                 break;
116:             }
117:         }
118: 
119:         if (!replaced) {
120:             rendered.append(placeholder);
121:         }
122:         pos = end + 2;
